title: Spin, occupation and condensation in the finite Fold model
description:
Every positive finite preserving population has one minimum-throw ground word. Its exact ground share strictly increases with cold depth and reaches the retained lock share at a uniquely first finite crossing.

Maria Smith derives the complete preserving and alternating occupation counts, exact normalization, cold-depth ordering, finite condensation bound and the full selected critical record in Smithian Fold Theory. The paper gives the mathematical constructions and induction proofs, typed spin-return orbits and the complete registered Bose-gas, Pauli-blocking and neutron-spinor comparisons.

Includes two exhaustive 256-form classifications, 312 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations, pinned V3 and V4 citations, original primary-source snapshots, native verification evidence and portable exact reproduction. Topics include Bose condensation, quantum statistics, fermion exclusion, spinor return, finite occupation measures and formal verification.

Read the complete paper (PDF). Full source and evidence archive included.
